comments: Listed as part of rNgog Blo ldan shes rab's compositions by several Tibetan scholars (see <<Kano 2016 [BAQ9MH4T]>>: 202). It would correspond to the "phar phyin Tik chen" listed in A khu ching Shes rab rgya mtsho's Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 528, No. 11470. A "don bsdus" is also listed, which is extant (ID:4435).
name: shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i rnam bshad
